notes: Sourced from Telemetrics' own manufacturer datasheet (hosted via AV-iQ CDN, dated 07/08/2019) for the "RCCP-2A LGS" (Legislative Software) variant, which is the same physical control-panel/I-O chassis as the base RCCP-2A with a different bundled software package — no separate base-model datasheet could be located, and Telemetrics' own site (telemetrics.com) now redirects through telemetricsinc.com to EVS's T-Motion product line (evs.com/solutions/t-motion), where the RCCP-2A is no longer listed, suggesting it may be discontinued/legacy. Corroborated as a real, distinct SKU (RCCP-2A, ~$16,000 list) via B&H Photo and EAR store listings, though those retailer pages carried no spec detail. It is a desktop control-surface unit, not rack-mountable (17"W x 8.75"D x 3.94"H, 9.9 lbs), so rackUnits is omitted. No bandwidth grade is stated for HD-SDI beyond "HD-SDI" (assumed sdi-hd, not confirmed 3G/6G capable) or for USB/HDMI (versions unstated, so grade omitted on those). The "Tally In/Control Out" connector's physical type (likely a multi-pin D-sub or terminal block for contact-closure tally/GPI, not literally RS-232 serial data) and the exact DC power connector style (barrel jack vs. locking DC connector) could not be confirmed from the datasheet and are best-guess mappings to the closest available connector IDs. DIP switches and the main power switch on the I/O panel are functional controls, not signal/power connectors, and were omitted.

ports.name: Tally In/Control Out
ports.note: Multi-pin tally/GPI control connector; exact pin/connector style not specified on datasheet, closest listed type used

ports.name: Power In
ports.note: 12VDC from included external power adapter (115-230VAC / 12VDC, 65W); exact DC connector style (barrel vs. locking) not specified on datasheet
